verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Linear supports personal API keys, OAuth2 apps (with JSON manifest generation) and agent/user permission mirroring via Okta, but nothing in the pack describes scoped, least-privilege, or permission-limited credentials specifically for agents (e.g., read-only keys, resource-restricted tokens, granular OAuth scopes). Admin spend limits and Okta identity sync address usage/access control, not credential scoping.
